structure.unit: Conduct of Trust Business by Banks

law.catch_line: Powers of national banks as fiduciaries
law.text: All national banks that have been, or hereafter may be, permitted by law to act as trustee and in other fiduciary capacities, shall have the rights, powers, privileges, and immunities conferred upon trust companies by Chapter 10 (§ 6.2-1000 et seq.).
